text: writerly that I do: Daniel Carpenter, Dan Coxon, Julia Lloyd, Richard Mason, Matt Snow, Cameron McClure, Katie Shea Boutillier, Rebecca Rowland, Philip Fracassi, Brian Keene, Clay McLeod Chapman, Kevin Kangas, Frank Spinney, Katharine Carroll, Bahar Kutluk, Isabelle Sinnott, Melody Wukitch of Park Books, my friends, and of course my family. This story takes place in Los Angeles, and while I don’t live there, fellow author Philip Fracassi does. He not only provided answers to my questions about L.A. throughout the writing of this novel, but supplied me with photographs, detailed maps, and more than just a handful of colorful anecdotes, some of which made it into the story itself. In an industry as cutthroat as publishing, Philip is one of the good guys. Go read his books. Ronald Malfi Annapolis, Maryland October 17, 2024 ABOUT THE AUTHOR R onald Malfi is the award-winning author of several horror novels and thrillers, including the bestseller Come with Me , published by Titan Books in 2021. He is the recipient of two Independent Publisher Book Awards, the Beverly Hills Book Award, the Vincent Preis Horror Award, the Benjamin Franklin Award, and his novel Floating Staircase was a finalist for the Bram Stoker Award ® .
